title: 5th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/2024).
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Health Services Act (Law No. 29/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Henveiru South MP Hussain Imran Latheef.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to begin debating the government's amendment to the Health Services Act.
